The dbt check for `01-marketing-mart` now **passes**. All 25 tests pass, and the earlier failure is fixed: `wh_core__order_fact.customer_fk` is now documented and tested in `dbt/models/schema.yml`.

## Test results

`dbt build` ran on the bundled DuckDB warehouse (the local database file). All 33 steps succeeded: 2 seeds, 6 models and 25 tests.

| Layer | Tests passed |
|---|---|
| Staging | 7 / 7 |
| Integration | 9 / 9 |
| Warehouse | 9 / 9 |

There were 23 tests last time. The 2 new ones are a "not empty" check and a "matches a customer" check on `customer_fk`.

## Convention checks

There are no project-specific rules files, so the standard Wire rules applied.

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| File names and folders | Pass. Names are singular and use the `stg_`, `int_`, `wh_..._dim` and `wh_..._fact` patterns. |
| Column names | Pass. Keys end in `_pk`, `_fk` or `_natural_key`, and timestamps in `_ts`. True/false columns start with `has_`, money columns end in `_amount`, and keys use `generate_surrogate_key`. |
| Column order | Pass in all 6 models. |
| SQL layout | Pass. Each model reads its inputs in `s_` blocks at the top and ends with `select * from final`. Joins are `left join`, with no single-letter table names. |
| Table vs view | Pass. Warehouse models build as tables; staging and integration as views. |
| Tests | Pass. Every primary key has both tests and every foreign key has a "matches" test. |
| Descriptions | Pass. Every staging and warehouse model and column has one, through shared description blocks in `field_descriptions.md`. |
| Links between models | Pass. All references resolve and run staging, then integration, then warehouse. |

## Remaining issues (none blocking)

| Level | Issue | Suggested change |
|---|---|---|
| Important | All 6 models are described in one `models/schema.yml`. The rules expect one file per folder. | Split it into `stg_shopify.yml`, `integration.yml` and `wh_core.yml`. |
| Info | Staging models read the seed files with `ref()` instead of `source()`. | None. The code comments say this is on purpose for the demo. |
| Info | sqlfluff (an automatic SQL style checker) is not installed, so I checked the style by eye. | Install sqlfluff for automated checks. |

## What I changed

- **Release status file** (`status.md`): set `validate: pass`, `review: not_started` and `tests_passed: 25`, set the current phase to `dbt_review`, and added a session history row.
- **Execution log** (`execution_log.md`): added a `pass` row.
- **Jira:** I did not sync anything; this release has no Jira set up.

The shared demo runner, which normally tells dbt how to connect, is outside the folders this session can open. So I wrote a short connection file in `dbt/.tmp_profile/`, used it for the build, and deleted it afterwards.

**Next step:** `/wire:dbt-review releases/01-marketing-mart`.
